blocks.title: Cookies
blocks.text: Cookies are small files that websites place on your device to remember things like your login details and preferences.
On a shopping site, cookies keep you logged in, but they can also track the products you view to show you related advertisements, which means your browsing is being observed.

blocks.prompt: Describe how cookies can be both helpful and invasive, with an example of each (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Helpful: a shopping site remembers your login and cart, so you do not sign in every visit. Invasive: tracking cookies record which products you view, possibly across sites, to build a profile for targeted advertising without you noticing.

items: Cookies: remember logins and preferences, but can track browsing for ads.
